chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 552 – The Evergreen's Betrayal and the Archer's Wrath
chapter_meta_description: The Evergreen Sword Immortal reveals his true colors, killing the Snowdance Fairy and five Karmic Punishment Deities in a devastating betrayal. But the Crimsonbright Realm retaliates with Dongzhe the Archer.
og_title: The Evergreen's Betrayal – A Realm War Shattered
og_description: The Evergreen Sword Immortal turns traitor, murdering his eternal companion and five Karmic Punishment Deities. Dongzhe the Archer arrives with a Chaos Daofruit to turn the tide.
twitter_title: Realm War Betrayal: The Evergreen Strikes
twitter_description: The Snowdance Fairy falls to her eternal companion's blade. The Seamless Gate launches a full assault. Dongzhe the Archer answers with a Chaos Daofruit.

lore_anchors.definition: Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A dragon-shaped war formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, capable of devastating coordinated attacks.
A condensed fragment of a True God Daofather's personal comprehension of Chaos, permanently sacrificed to grant a cultivator a temporary burst of Daofather-threshold power.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; the foundation of supreme archery arts.
Battle puppets formed by Celestial Immortals dissolving their formation and reassembling into smaller, individually more powerful combat units.
Three powerful demon gods who can merge into a single three-eyed Fiendgod through a unity formation, multiplying their combat power.
One of the supreme archers of the Three Realms, a Heartforce master at the fourth level of perfection, whose arrows can strike fear into any Heavenly God or True Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Evergreen Sword Immortal betray them?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was a Seamless Gate sleeper agent planted long ago, activated at the critical moment to create a battlefield shift by killing the Snowdance Fairy and the five Karmic Punishment Deities.
A rare, non-renewable fruit condensed from a Daofather's comprehension of Chaos; consuming it grants a temporary burst of Daofather-level power, but only for a few shots.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Dongzhe killing White-Faced Flood Dragons instead of enemy commanders?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Heavenly Gods and True Immortals can coordinate defenses to survive his arrows, but a single shot can destroy multiple White-Faced Flood Dragons, killing thousands of Celestial Immortals at once.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did the White-Faced Flood Dragons turn into Heavenly God Puppets?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The formations dissolved and reassembled; a thousand Celestial Immortals forming one White-Faced Flood Dragon can instead form ten Heavenly God Puppets for more efficient combat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the Snowdance Fairy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She was killed by the Evergreen Sword Immortal, her eternal companion, in a cold-blooded betrayal that stunned the entire battlefield.
